properties.name: sauti.required-env
properties.description: Environment variables that must be set and non-blank before the application may start. Each profile that talks to real services lists its own; startup fails naming every missing one.

properties.name: sauti.crypto.encryption-key
properties.description: AES-256-GCM key for encrypted columns: 32 random bytes in Base64. Set through APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

properties.name: sauti.crypto.hash-key
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 key for lookup hashes of encrypted values: 32 random bytes in Base64, different from the encryption key. Set through HASH_KEY.

properties.name: sauti.first-admin.email
properties.description: Login email of the admin created at startup while the staff table is empty. Set through FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL.

properties.name: sauti.first-admin.password
properties.description: One-time password for the first admin, at least 12 characters, changed at first login. Set through FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD.

properties.name: sauti.first-admin.name
properties.description: Display name of the first admin. Set through FIRST_ADMIN_NAME.

properties.name: sauti.storage.endpoint
properties.description: S3 endpoint URL for audio storage. Set through STORAGE_ENDPOINT.

properties.name: sauti.storage.bucket
properties.description: Bucket for encrypted audio pieces. Set through STORAGE_BUCKET.

properties.name: sauti.storage.access-key
properties.description: Storage access key id. Set through STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY.

properties.name: sauti.storage.secret-key
properties.description: Storage secret key. Set through STORAGE_SECRET_KEY.

properties.name: sauti.storage.region
properties.description: Signing region; R2 accepts auto.

properties.name: sauti.storage.create-bucket
properties.description: Create the bucket at startup if missing; development and tests only.

properties.name: sauti.time-zone
properties.description: The facility's time zone, for local days such as queue number resets.

properties.name: sauti.jobs.enabled
properties.description: Whether the background job worker runs; tests switch it off and drive it directly.

properties.name: sauti.jobs.poll-ms
properties.description: Milliseconds between job polls.

properties.name: sauti.jobs.recover-ms
properties.description: Milliseconds between recoveries of stuck jobs.

properties.name: sauti.transcription.provider
properties.description: Which transcriber to use: fake (development and tests) or groq.

properties.name: sauti.transcription.groq.base-url
properties.description: Groq's OpenAI-compatible API root.

properties.name: sauti.transcription.groq.api-key
properties.description: Groq API key. Set through GROQ_API_KEY.

properties.name: sauti.transcription.groq.model
properties.description: Whisper model name.

properties.name: sauti.transcription.groq.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout for Groq.

properties.name: sauti.transcription.groq.read-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait for a transcription.

properties.name: sauti.ai.provider
properties.description: Which clinical AI to use: fake (development and tests) or groq.

properties.name: sauti.ai.groq.base-url
properties.description: Groq's OpenAI-compatible API root for the clinical AI.

properties.name: sauti.ai.groq.api-key
properties.description: Groq API key. Set through GROQ_API_KEY.

properties.name: sauti.ai.groq.model
properties.description: The pinned chat model.

properties.name: sauti.ai.groq.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout for the clinical AI.

properties.name: sauti.ai.groq.read-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait for a summary (20 seconds).
